title: Sámi languages - Wikipedia
text: The Sámi languages form a branch of the Uralic language family. According to the traditional view, Sámi is within the Uralic family most closely related to the Finnic languages (Sammallahti 1998).

text: Sami languages belong to the Finno-Ugric branch of the Uralic language family. There are 11 Sami languages, 9 of which are still in use to some degree.Western Sami languages, which are also spoken in Sweden and Norway, include Pite, Lule, South, and North Sami.
